name: Immutable Episodic Event Log
mechanism: Records selected source events as immutable episodes with actor, time, scope, origin, permissions and causal links before any derived summarization.
use_when: Future tasks need auditable recall of prior interactions or outcomes
Derived memories must remain traceable to original evidence
avoid_when: Retention has no explicit purpose or lawful basis
Raw events contain secrets that should not be persisted
expected_effects: Replayable provenance for later memory transformations
Separation of source evidence from model-generated memory
failure_modes: Overcapture retains irrelevant or sensitive content
Missing actor or time corrupts later interpretation
Mutable updates erase the original evidence
required_evals: equal-budget raw-log BM25 temporal and local-expansion baseline
ingest storage retrieval and answer cost per correct answer
